schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs; 4–6 transcript (never shown to students); 7–10 listening answers; 11–14 composition marking, symbols, 40-mark table and short-attempt columns; 32–33 modified marking (SMM, incl. the composition 40-mark table). PDF 15–31 are Paper 2; 34–35 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (answer-booklet pages 8–15 are ruled writing space) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: One SEC recording serves the Higher and Ordinary 2022 listening test; Ordinary asks different questions on the same extracts. The 2022 listening cards already play it.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. I gCorcaigh / Corcaigh / Siopa éadaí / Siopa carthanachta) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: the six retained legacy segment cards keep their IDs and stay the card unit, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card (already carded, IDs retained). Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email, recipient (deartháir/deirfiúr) and conversation partner wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6; every question 3 marks) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” (scheme PDF 3 and 10) is one section-level deduction; cards state it without applying it.
The 2022 scheme prints no general listening note (2023 prints one on PDF 7); the annotation-symbol table on PDF 7 follows Fógra a hAon and is removed from its answer key.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each segment card had one undivided criterion; the nine composition cards carried the 2021–2022 legacy composition text. All now carry the lifted 2022 scheme text and per-question tariffs.
